description:
Fill in the security-relevant fields of the F# `Language_plugin.t` descriptor. The list was scoped in the parent epic; this ticket lands it.

Lists to add to `src/ocaml/lib/catseye_ast/fsharp_plugin.ml`

`taint_sources` (untrusted data entering the program):
- `System.Console.ReadLine`
- `System.Console.In.ReadLine`
- `System.Console.ReadKey`
- `System.Environment.GetCommandLineArgs`
- `System.Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable`
- `System.IO.Console.In`
- `System.Net.Http.HttpClient.GetStringAsync`
- `System.Net.WebClient.DownloadString`

`taint_sinks` (data leaving the program / executing):
- `System.Console.Write`
- `System.Console.WriteLine`
- `printf`
- `eprintf`
- `fprintf`
- `System.IO.File.WriteAllText`
- `System.IO.File.AppendAllText`
- `System.IO.File.WriteAllLines`
- `System.IO.File.AppendAllLines`
- `System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes`
- `System.Diagnostics.Process.Start`
- `System.Net.Http.HttpClient.PostAsync`
- `System.Net.Http.HttpClient.PutAsync`
- `System.Net.Http.HttpClient.SendAsync`
- `System.Net.WebClient.DownloadFile`
- `System.Data.SqlClient.SqlCommand` (constructor; parameter-taken)
- `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SqlCommand`

`skip_calls`:
- `ignore`
- `id`
- `failwith`
- `failwithf`
- `invalidArg`
- `raise`

Acceptance
- Lists match the scope documented in the parent epic (catseye-9mh).
- No false positives on the smoke fixture (catseye-9mh.7).
- A comment in the plugin file documents the criteria for adding to each list (so future contributors don't cargo-cult).

Blocked by: catseye-9mh.4.
Worktree: `catseye-9mh.6/fsharp-taint-lists`.
title: F# taint sources / sinks / skip_calls in plugin descriptor
